headline: US Opens New Iran Strike Wave Amid Regional Escalation
subheadline: Explosions reported in Shiraz, Bushehr, Bandar Abbas, and Tehran-area locations including Parchin and Pakdasht.
lede: The United States military announced a new wave of strikes against Iran with explosions reported deep inside the country including Shiraz, Bushehr, Bandar Abbas, and Tehran-area locations. Iran's Revolutionary Guards downed an MQ-9 drone over Andimeshk and launched ballistic missiles from western Iran, Azerbaijan, and Lorestan provinces. Israeli forces killed two Hamas Nukhba commanders in northern Gaza Strip in a precise aerial strike. US Central Command stated it disabled an empty tanker headed toward an Iranian port in the Persian Gulf after it ignored warnings.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Continue Across Ukraine
sections.body: Russian forces conducted multiple strikes across Ukraine overnight, targeting infrastructure and civilian areas. Ukrainian forces reported destroying a Russian Mi-28 helicopter on Belgorod region. Ukrainian forces struck 20 ships in the Black Sea overnight, including 17 oil tankers and 2 gas carriers. Multiple drone attacks reported across Ukraine including reactive drones from Kharkiv toward Zhytomyr region.

sections.title: US-Iran Confrontation Escalates Regionally
sections.body: The US military announced the opening of an additional wave of attacks against Iran with explosions reported in Shiraz and deep inside the country. The Revolutionary Guards public relations stated an MQ-9 hostile drone was spotted and downed over Andimeshk by an air-defense system of the aerospace force. Iran launched ballistic missiles from western Iran, Azerbaijan Province, and Lorestan Province according to field monitoring. Israeli forces killed two Hamas Nukhba Force commanders in northern Gaza Strip in a precise aerial strike last night.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The escalation indicates direct US-Iran confrontation with regional spillover via Iranian proxies in Iraq, Kuwait, Jordan, and Lebanon. Russian forces continue aggressive strikes across Ukraine targeting infrastructure and civilian areas. The threat level remains high with continuous attacks reported across multiple regions in both conflicts.
